Procedure title: TII390_M110_Enabling Works and Specialist Heritage Works Framework for MetroLink
Description: MetroLink will provide a high speed, high capacity, high frequency, modern and efficient public transport service for passengers travelling along the Swords/Airport to City Centre corridor in Dublin, which will be capable of integration with other modes of public transport. Further information on MetroLink is available at www.metrolink.ie/ In advance of the MetroLink main infrastructure works contracts, TII will commence the procurement of the Enabling Works Programme. The Enabling Works Programme comprises the establishment of a suite of framework agreements and qualification systems select contractors to deliver enabling works which will commence in advance of the main infrastructure works contracts (in respect of civil engineering, tunnelling and station works). The enabling works will include the removal and/or relocation of existing utilities, archaeology, heritage items (for storage/replacement) and buildings from site and undertaking other survey activities. To deliver the enabling and advance works for MetroLink, TII intends to establish 3 no. multi-party framework agreements as listed below each through a negotiated procedure with a prior call for competition. • Enabling Works and Specialist Heritage Works Framework; • Utilities Framework; and • Civils Enabling Works Framework. TII also intends to establish a qualification system for independent environmental monitoring and a qualification system for archaeology services as part of the Enabling Works Programme. The proposed duration of the framework agreements is 8 years with an option to extend for 4 years to facilitate the procurement of any associated works that may be required over the duration of the Frameworks. This PIN is in connection with the Enabling Works and Specialist Heritage Works Framework. The purpose of this PIN is to alert the market to TII’s intention to undertake market consultation and subsequently commence a procurement in Q3 2025.
